comment: The nightly refresh contract (2026-07-14, from the external security audit; tightened by the same-day re-audit). Every requirement here must have a row in data/run-manifest.json each run — src/check-refresh.mjs enforces it in the publish gate (--manifest) and the heartbeat (--age). maxAgeDays = staleness alert threshold for the committed data (alerts fire even for EXPLAINED staleness — visibility, not blame). rows.min = catastrophic-shrink floor, set ~60-65% of the 2026-07-14 real counts; raise/lower only with a reviewed reason. Date probes: pages = oldest matching sources.json page snapshot (a lagging page is a finding); metrics/ptrDummy = the COVERAGE date, i.e. the min-th-freshest asOf (min = date.minFresh, else rows.min, else 1) — one fresh row cannot vouch for a cut whose other role cuts/specs stayed old. evidence: "wcl" marks requirements cross-checked against wcl-fetch/evidence.json (written by the deterministic credentialed fetch step, uploaded before the agent runs): a success row needs evidence-landed rows, not just the agent's word. wcl-dummy-raw floors were tightened to min 60 + maxAgeDays 10 on 2026-07-17 after the first verified landing (103 rows). 2026-07-24 audit (D3/D4/N5): date probes for murlok, mythicstats, simulationcraft, bloodmallet and the three page-probed WCL cuts now read the DATA's own coverage date rather than the agent-written sources.json page snapshot — before this, rewriting 106 metric rows to 53 days stale while leaving snapshots at today produced zero violations from either gate. New probe type fightProfiles covers spec.fightProfile.asOf (sims live outside spec.metrics). encounterTiers ROW probes now count tier rows, not encounters: a partial Archon parse keeps all 17 encounters and empties their tier maps, so the old probe scored 17 while 92.5% of the surface was gone. archon-hps and archon-mplus-score were added — 47 published rows previously had neither a date gate nor a row floor. minSuccessfulSources = catastrophe floor: a run where essentially nothing arrived must not publish as a quiet night. Re-based 10 -> 7 at the 2026-08-18 S2 flip (owner-acked in the flip review): the contract shrank 26 -> 19 requirements and four of the previous night's 11 successes (icyveins-ptr + the three deterministic PTR raw-WCL rows) left with it, so 10 of 19 would red every transition night on sources sitting at their honest season-boundary freeze. 7 is the proportional re-base (10/26 of 19); healthy pre-flip runs sat at 17-19 of 25 — RECALIBRATE upward once S2 upstreams (Archon numerics, Murlok, Mythicstats, WCL live) are flowing and a healthy S2 run count has been observed. | minSuccessfulSources LOWERED 7->5 for the S2 transition window (Riley, 2026-08-19): the 08-18 dispatch nightly failed the floor HONESTLY at 5 — Archon frozen mid-S2-rebuild, WoWMeta frozen upstream, wcl-live x2 in their owner-accepted standing red. RESTORE TO 7 by ~2026-09-01 once sources rebuild for S2; a below-5 night is still a real failure.

gearing.comment: Freshness for the gearing subproject (gearing/README.md), added 2026-08-08. Deliberately a SIBLING of requirements[] rather than an entry in it: requirements[] is consumed by checkManifest as well as checkFreshness, so a row there would make the nightly publish gate demand a run-manifest entry for a subproject the nightly cannot refresh — gearing harvests are MANUAL because Wowhead is unreachable from CI. A sibling key is read only by the loop that iterates it, which is a structural guarantee rather than a convention. It is also deliberately NOT in gearing/src/validate-data.mjs, so npm test (nightly Gate 1) can never go red on a date the nightly has no way to fix. Thresholds are loose on purpose: there is no observed re-harvest cadence to calibrate against (zero re-harvests since the 2026-08-04 import), so the job here is to make rot visible, not to nag about lag. The check that actually earns its keep is tierSetSync, which measures WRONGNESS rather than age — it fires when the page is publishing tier-set text the tracker has already corrected, which is exactly the Preservation Evoker failure of 2026-08-08. Brings forward the freshness contract row listed as Phase C in docs/s2-transition-scope.md.

requirements.label: Icy Veins tier lists (raid + M+, all roles)
requirements.comment: published block added 2026-08-05 (owner-directed, after the seasonVerified/published Gate 0 widening in e65332a made the field agent-writable): the dishonesty-class cross-check against published-evidence/evidence.json is the real point — it catches a rebuilt page behind a repeated stale claim the same night (the 08-02 icyveins-ptr incident shape). maxAgeDays 45 is deliberately loose: these LIVE pages rebuild on patch cadence, not weekly (observed gap ~35 days, oldest page 2026-06-30 at seeding), so a tight number would fire immediately and permanently. 45 stays quiet now and fires ~08-15 only if Icy Veins has not rebuilt its live lists days after 12.1 ships — a genuinely alarm-worthy state. RETIGHTEN once the Season 2 rebuild cadence has been observed (wowmeta-note precedent).

requirements.label: Wowhead tier lists (raid + M+, all roles)
requirements.comment: published block added 2026-08-05 alongside icyveins' (same rationale — the cross-check is the point; requires the full-browser-header transport in fetch-published.mjs, since wowhead 403s a UA-only fetch and would otherwise sit permanently unresolved). maxAgeDays 120 looks absurd and is honest: Wowhead's live tier-list pages self-date 2026-04-19..2026-06-25 at seeding — the oldest is already 108 days — so any tighter number is a permanently-red alarm nobody reads. 120 stays quiet now and fires ~08-18 only if the 04-19 page still has not rebuilt a week into 12.1. RETIGHTEN after the Season 2 rebuild lands and a real cadence is observable; if these pages simply never re-date outside season boundaries, ~40 (one season phase + slack) is the likely resting value.

Archon 95th-pct DPS (raid — DPS + tank rows, from specRankingsSection; HPS and M+ score are their own rows). The 2026-08-21 standing red (S2 rebuild served 0 rows) RESOLVED 2026-08-25 in a reviewed local run: the repopulated S2 tables were merged wholesale, and Fire Mage — which has no S2 row because nobody logs it at Mythic — had its S1 rows DROPPED rather than held, so the rank pool stays season-uniform (validate.mjs now gates that shape). Fire Mage reads pending until Archon publishes it; that is data, not a failure.

Archon 95th-pct HPS (raid, healers). The 2026-08-21 standing red (healer page served 0 rows) RESOLVED 2026-08-24/25: the S2 healer table repopulated, all 7 rows merged by the 08-25 nightly and re-upserted from the same 08-25T12:00 dataset as archon-metrics in the follow-up local run. Kept as its own row per the split-row rule.

Archon popularity % (raid + M+, from specRankingsSection — the series a 07-21 recipe-navigation error silently stalled). The 2026-08-21 standing red RESOLVED 2026-08-25: the raid DPS group merged once the S2 tables repopulated, with Fire Mage's leftover S1 share DROPPED rather than held (a published sum-to-100 group cannot carry a stale extra share — it summed to 101.5). All role groups sum to 100.0 again; 79 rows, Fire Mage pending upstream.

WoWMeta M+ population lb_ci rating (metrics; letters retired 2026-07-31). OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED (2026-08-21, Riley): UPSTREAM is frozen, not our fetch — manifest.json snapshotDate and the rankings file's Last-Modified both read 2026-08-11 and agree, and the payload is diffed each run rather than trusted to the manifest (the 08-04 pinned-manifest shape). Nothing to merge means the coverage date correctly does not move. Do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays; it clears when WoWMeta re-runs.
requirements.note: maxAgeDays raised 4 -> 8 on 2026-07-31. The 4 was never exercised: until the retype the stored date was agent-written and therefore always today, so the gate could not fire. asOf is now the source-published snapshotDate, which legitimately lags (07-28 on a 07-31 run), and 8 absorbs a weekly cadence while still catching a genuine freeze. Retighten once WoWMeta’s real cadence has been observed over a few cycles.
